custom_label_audit.scene_grouping_policy: All custom views retain one user-confirmed shared filming-batch union. This grouping is verified only as a conservative leakage-prevention union; individual scene/camera pairs remain unverified.
custom_label_audit.review_instructions: Open the local silent prepared_path video and review its complete duration. Use label=violation with event_times in elapsed video seconds, for example [12.5, 27], or label=no_violation with event_times=[]. Leave uncertain cases unreviewed. After visual verification, set review_status=human_verified, full_video_reviewed=yes, reviewer to your identifier and reviewed_at_utc to an ISO UTC timestamp such as 2026-10-18T10:00:00Z. Do not copy labels between cameras: visibility and recording start times can differ. Scene pairing is a separate review; labels do not establish pair correspondence.

limitations: This model family was designed after earlier comparisons; original recordings remain repeatedly inspected development data.
Group folds prevent declared related views crossing folds; original source-hash groups are recording groups, not verified independent scenes.
Point anchors are incomplete; point recall is measurable, event precision and interval IoU are not identifiable.
Scores are uncalibrated; pooled AP/AUC combine independently fitted outer models.
Frozen frame embeddings may lose hand/object detail and motion between samples; no new visual evidence is created by interpolation.
Max/top-k summaries and sequence boundaries can still encode observation length, despite no duration/filename predictor.
No accuracy guarantee, legal event interpretation, or verified custom labels follows from training or synthetic tests.
